The Doctrine of the Mean

Quotes / The Doctrine of the Mean / Q0155

English

Sincerity is the Way of Heaven; making oneself sincere is the way of human beings.
Thinker The Doctrine of the Mean
School Confucianism
Source Liji, Zhongyong
Theme Sincerity
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Liji, Zhongyong, within the tradition of Confucianism. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of sincerity, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In The Doctrine of the Mean's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
